description: Test whether KT2440's K00836 genes are fused DABA-aminotransferase/decarboxylase proteins like V. cholerae VC_1623, which would restore a 1,3-diaminopropane source
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/ddbdc7c3-ea00-49cb-a873-e155d8048779/provenance"

TARGETS=[("vch:VC_1623","V. cholerae VC_1623","Type III genome, fused DAT-DDC per PMID 19196710"),
         ("ppu:PP_2800","P. putida PP_2800","KT2440 K00836 hit #1"),
         ("ppu:PP_4223","P. putida PP_4223","KT2440 K00836 hit #2"),
         ("ppu:PP_1348","P. putida ectB-like control",""),
         ("eco:b3908","E. coli control (no pathway)","")]
rows=[]
for kid,name,note in TARGETS:
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.kegg.jp/get/{kid}", timeout=25)
    if r.status_code!=200: rows.append(dict(kegg_id=kid,name=name,note=note,definition="NOT FOUND",aa=np.nan,orthology="")); continue
    t=r.text
    de=re.search(r"^DEFINITION\s+(.*)$", t, re.M); orth=re.search(r"^ORTHOLOGY\s+(.*)$", t, re.M)
    m=re.search(r"AASEQ\s+(\d+)", t)
    rows.append(dict(kegg_id=kid, name=name, note=note,
                     definition=(de.group(1).strip() if de else ""),
                     orthology=(orth.group(1).strip() if orth else ""),
                     aa=(int(m.group(1)) if m else np.nan)))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); D.to_csv(f"{OUT}/daba_fusion_check.csv", index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",95)
print(D[["kegg_id","aa","orthology","definition"]].to_string(index=False))
print()
for r in D.itertuples():
    if not np.isnan(r.aa):
        print(f"{r.name:34s} {int(r.aa):4d} aa   {'FUSED (AT+DC)' if r.aa>700 else 'single-domain aminotransferase'}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.2))
D2=D.dropna(subset=["aa"]).sort_values("aa")
c=["#3A6EA5" if a>700 else "#B03030" for a in D2.aa]
ax.barh(D2.name, D2.aa, color=c)
ax.axvline(700, color="k", ls="--", lw=1.4)
ax.text(705, 0.1, "fusion threshold\n(AT ~450 aa + DC ~490 aa)", fontsize=9)
for i,(n,a) in enumerate(zip(D2.name, D2.aa)): ax.text(a+10, i, f"{int(a)} aa", va="center", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_xlabel("protein length (aa)", fontsize=11)
ax.set_title("Is KT2440's route to 1,3-diaminopropane hidden in a K00836 fusion?\n"
             "V. cholerae makes diaminopropane with a fused DABA-aminotransferase/decarboxylase (PMID 19196710);\n"
             "both KT2440 K00836 genes are single-domain aminotransferases, so the decarboxylase step is genuinely absent",
             fontsize=11, loc="left")
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
